bugs.error_message: error TS2339 / TS4112 in ErrorBoundary.tsx with React 19 types
bugs.root_cause: Missing @types/react and @types/react-dom in devDependencies left React untyped, and constructor-based state in class component failed TS override checks in React 19.
bugs.fix: Installed @types/react@^19 and @types/react-dom@^19, refactored ErrorBoundary to declare `public override state: State` directly and explicit static getDerivedStateFromError signature.

bugs.error_message: error TS2741: Property 'cardBg' is missing in type passed to DeckSearchModal
bugs.root_cause: 10 themes passed styles to DeckSearchModal omitting cardBg (only providing accent, bg, textColor, borderColor), but styles.cardBg was strictly required.
bugs.fix: Made cardBg optional in DeckSearchModalProps (cardBg?: string) with fallback to styles.bg.

bugs.error_message: error TS2345 in UnifiedGame.tsx: missing intensity and gameMode in SetStateAction<CustomDeck>
bugs.root_cause: setEditingDeck was called with a newly created deck missing required intensity and gameMode fields.
bugs.fix: Supplied current active intensity and gameMode (with fallbacks) when initializing new deck.

bugs.error_message: error TS2322 in PersonaTheme.tsx: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'AnimationGeneratorType'
bugs.root_cause: P5_VARIANTS transition had type: 'spring' inferred as string rather than string literal type.
bugs.fix: Added `as const` to spring type and easeInOut transition in P5_VARIANTS.
